preview.text: Australia Champions and West Indies Champions meet in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. Australia Champions won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 31 degrees.

summary.text: AUSCH posted 172-7 with Joe Burns top scoring with 86 off 52 balls, while Sheldon Cottrell took 4 for 20. WICH replied with 173-5 as Chadwick Walton (wk) top scored with 87 off 42 balls, and Nathan Coulter-Nile claimed 2 for 19. West Indies Champions won the match by 5 wkts.
